ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: SW — Shokk
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SHOKK_RSW_MOD_1 (owner ruling, 2026-09-11, on the webwork kit-placement card, verbatim: "The Shokk feels like it's becoming its own MandrakeStarWars level mod, with the rest of the mechanics in this biome party of the Utinni scenario.") — the Wyyyschokk's own behavior, generalized so any Star Wars scenario can use it, extracted out of `design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/kits/webwork_kit_spec.md` (WEBWORK_MECHANICS_1, never itself built — this mod is that spec's Shokk slice, built for the first time here).
**Species ownership note**: the Wyyyschokk ThingDef/PawnKindDef itself is NOT ours to move — it is a live def inside the third-party Workshop mod `mlie.starwarsanimalcollection` (Star Wars Animal Collection), confirmed by direct search of this repo: every existing reference (BeastNorm_Law3.xml's Law-3 damage patch, MegafaunaYield.xml's yield-stat patch, RUT_Webwork.xml's wildAnimals entry) is a PatchOperation targeting `ThingDef[defName="Wyyyschokk"]` in that external mod, never a def declaration of our own. The item's premise ("find its current def... and MOVE it") does not hold: there is no RUT_-owned Wyyyschokk def anywhere in this repo to relocate; it has never been absorbed the way Bantha/Jerba were. What ships here instead is everything that IS ours to own — new content authored fresh against the spec, applied to the external species by patch, exactly as BeastNorm/MegafaunaYield already do:
1. `RSW_ShokkBound` (HediffDef) — re-tokened RSW_ from the spec's provisional RUT_ name. The mouth-loom's bind: near-immobilizes rather than wounds (capMods, no direct damage), decays slowly untended, resolves fast under a doctor's tend (HediffCompProperties_TendDuration). 2. `RSW_Damage_ShokkSpit` (DamageDef, ParentName="Bullet") — near-zero direct damage; its whole purpose is `additionalHediffs` → RSW_ShokkBound. 3. `RSW_Bullet_ShokkSpit` + `RSW_Gun_ShokkSpit` — the projectile and the turret-gun wrapper (RimWorld.CompTurretGun, the same mechanism vanilla's heavy mechanoids use to give a PAWN a ranged attack) that the Wyyyschokk patch attaches, giving the spider a genuine ranged "spit" without any new C# combat code — `CompTurretGun` already implements `IAttackTargetSearcher` and slots into the vanilla combat AI for any pawn, mechanoid or animal. 4. `RSW_Webwork_SunScald` (HediffDef) — the light-moat, RULED 2026-09-11: cripples (MoveSpeed postFactor down to ~0.3, "crawl for shade"), NEVER downs — every stage uses postFactor, never a capacity floor, so Moving can shrink but never hit zero. Its hediffClass, `RimMandrake.CreatureBehaviors.RM_Hediff_SunScald`, is generic (any species, any planet) and lives in the shared `mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors` assembly per the owner's ruling that the RM_ mechanics kit's classes belong there, not in a per-biome DLL — this mod supplies only the tuned XML HediffDef and the patch that attaches it via PawnKindDef.startingHediffs. The class is keyed to `RimWorld.SanguophageUtility.InSunlight` (unroofed + sky glow, the same primitive the vanilla UV-sensitivity gene uses) — canon note, 2026-09-11: there is no night on Ash'karr's dayside and no lamp ever substitutes for the sun there, but on any OTHER planet the identical primitive already turns this off at night on its own; nothing here special-cases Ash'karr. 5. `RSW_CompEmergentSpawnOnDestroy` — the emergent-Shokk spawn hook (RULED 2026-09-11, owner-verbatim on the sole-source boundary card: "it has a small chance of SPAWNING an emergent Shokk to get you"). A small, reusable ThingComp: attach it (via `RSW_CompProperties_EmergentSpawnOnDestroy`) to any Thing whose destruction represents a harvest, and on a `DestroyMode.Vanish` it rolls a configurable chance to spawn a hostile Wyyyschokk (soft `DefDatabase<PawnKindDef>` lookup by name — inert, never errors, if the species mod is absent) at the spot, manhunter-forced. Not yet wired to any recipe: the creep-web harvest that will attach this comp belongs to `SHOKKWEAVE_SOLE_SOURCE_1`, unbuilt as of this mod's creation — this ships the mechanism the Utinni layer will consume.
**What stayed RUT_/Utinni** (per the same ruling): the web-sense MapComponent's biome gating, creep-web terrain, the sole-source boundary, and every other webwork_kit_spec.md mechanic not named above. The Utinni layer (`UtinniPatches`) is a CONSUMER of this mod — it references RSW_ defs across the mod boundary — never the owner of Shokk-specific content.
Live proof is OWED beyond this build's own quicktest verification: the full webwork biome kit (web-sense, ambush, margin creep) has never been built — only this mod's Shokk slice has, against a forced-biome quicktest map.
